# garage_bucket (Data Source)

Look up a Garage bucket by ID or global alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by global alias
data "garage_bucket" "website" {
  global_alias = "my-website"
}

# Look up by ID
data "garage_bucket" "specific" {
  id = "0123456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `global_alias` (String) Global alias to look up.
- `id` (String) Bucket identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `global_alias` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Total size of objects in the bucket (bytes).
- `created` (String) Bucket creation timestamp.
- `error_document` (String) Error document for website access.
- `global_aliases` (List of String) List of all global aliases for this bucket.
- `index_document` (String) Index document for website access.
- `max_objects` (Number) Maximum number of objects in the bucket.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum total size of objects in the bucket (bytes).
- `objects` (Number) Number of objects in the bucket.
- `unfinished_multipart_upload_bytes` (Number) Total bytes in unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_multipart_upload_parts` (Number) Number of parts in unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_multipart_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished uploads.
- `website_access` (Boolean) Whether website access is enabled.
